correctness.rationale: Every minimal cover of the full subdivision yields an independent omitted-original set and a spanning tree on its connected complement; all chosen subdivision vertices are uniquely forced by the cut or that tree. Conversely every constructed set is minimally connected-covering, with original-vertex indispensability proved by three exhaustive cases using minimum degree at least two; upward closure upgrades one-deletion tests to inclusion minimality. The size formula and K_{2,q} specialization were derived symbolically. Independent brute-force definition checks over 264 labeled base graphs (orders 3--5) and K_{2,q} tests through q=6 matched exactly; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The all-cover structural classification holds for every connected input graph of minimum degree at least two, converting the entire family into a weighted spanning-tree transform; it classifies all minimum covers beyond canonical tree solutions. The explicit \(K_{2,q}\) family has \(q-3\) absent consecutive cardinalities for every \(q\ge4\) and yields exact coefficients \(q3^{q-1}\) and \(2\). These are natural enumerative invariants and an unbounded structural phenomenon, not routine scalar recalculation.
